create_builtin_decorator: create a Builtin decorator to define a typed function signature without implementation
configure_builtin_implementation: configure a Builtin with an implementation function and default arguments
update_builtin_defaults: update default argument values of an already configured Builtin function
call_configured_builtin: call a configured Builtin function that resolves to its registered implementation
compare_type_annotations: compare generic type annotations with TypeVars for signature validation
